Here’s a simple breakdown of the main options we offer:

Paying: You can pay with MasterCard, Amex, Visa, or PayPal.
Emails: Use “Manage My Preferences” in any CAMILLA email to choose which emails you receive.
Delivery: Choose a delivery type at checkout; standard/express come Mon–Fri, 8am–6pm, and large items ship at a flat $35 per piece.
Ordering help: You can place orders yourself online, visit a boutique, or get help from our customer care angels via live chat, phone, or email.
Order confirmation: After payment, you’ll see an order confirmation page, get a confirmation email, and the order appears in your account order history.
